core: Two mutually exclusive exhaustive YES/NO outcomes,zero initial quantities and fixed positive b
Stable max-shift Decimal cost/prices; named finite precision and rounding tolerances

recommendation.scientific_limit: Mechanism/accounting correctness does not establish market efficiency,calibrated probabilities or real-world forecasting accuracy. All examples synthetic play credits; no real money or service connections.

supported_candidate: Offline one-market binary fixed-liquidity synthetic play ledger
Stable bounded pricing and explicit rounding/funding conventions

unsupported: Authenticated external resolution or empirical trader accuracy

conventions: Zero initial q and one-credit payoff per winning share are required for the stated b ln2 baseline. Long-only account positions sum to pricing quantities.

Use independent Decimal120 direct-exp oracle and stable max-shift Decimal80 production. ln/exp are approximations; verify absolute tolerances and extreme accepted ratios. Never label them exact fractions.

Propose monetary potential rounded HALF_EVEN to1e-24; executed charge is difference of two rounded TOTAL potentials. Ledger cash telescopes exactly on this grid,including reversals; do not round each incremental analytic charge independently.

Ideal max(q)<=C(q),so max(q)-(C(q)-C(0))<=b ln2. Quantized potentials add at most one cash quantum plus numerical error; reserve ceiling(b ln2+2quanta) provides declared conservative funding margin. Freeze/independently verify before implementation.
Quotes show hypothetical charges and feasibility but do not move cash/positions. Confirmed execution binds quote intent,actor and current economic revision; stale quotes refuse.
Valid economic refusals are explicit rejected actions with unchanged financial state; structural malformed requests reject entirely. No failed action silently mutates accounts.

Idempotent event intent excludes delivery timestamp,so exact intent retries at later declared time cannot duplicate financial effects. Conflicting reuse of same ID refuses; immutable original ledger retained.

Trades/quotes require time strictly before close_at; clock closure may occur without explicit close action. This differs from51/57forecast cutoff-inclusive convention and must be documented,not silently mapped.

Resolution actor must equal declared authority and occur at/after close. Equality is a local declaration,not external authentication. Settle once; retain historical positions with settled flag and no remaining payout liability.

Cumulative trader cash plus maker cash equals total initial synthetic endowments. Maker initial reserve is a separate computed synthetic endowment,not deducted from trader credit allocations. No later deposits,fees,transfers or margin lending.

Stable price computation evaluates both softmax numerators separately to preserve tiny positive complements. Dominant price may round to1 at extreme ratios; normalization is tolerance-based,not an exact-real claim.
All repository data self-authored synthetic; no real traders,capital,transaction data or copyrighted material redistributed.
